runs.goal_hypothesis: Measure the high coefficient-0.40 endpoint in a controlled block-reward sweep.

results_insights.insight: High block reward nearly eliminated terminal wins.
The block signal dominated diagnostics without translating to evaluation wins.

reasoning: Coefficient 0.40 appears to overemphasize blocking at the expense of winning.
The group sweep holds other logged knobs fixed, supporting coefficient attribution.
One stochastic run and finite evaluation still limit precision.

runs.goal_hypothesis: Test moderate coefficient 0.25 relative to high-coefficient control d6f58cab1784484aa56b29a8f6452e45.

results_insights.insight: Worst-side wins became nonzero and led the sweep.
A smaller realized block signal coincided with much stronger play.

reasoning: Moderate block reward best balanced blocking and winning in this sweep.
The coefficient-only delta supports a controlled comparison.
Replication is needed because PPO seeds and evaluation samples can vary.

runs.goal_hypothesis: Test low coefficient 0.10 against moderate coefficient 0.25 under the same curriculum.

results_insights.insight: Low coefficient beat 0.40 but trailed 0.25 by 0.0933.
The realized shaping signal was much smaller.

reasoning: Coefficient 0.10 under-incentivized blocks relative to the sweep optimum.
The matched sweep supports a non-monotonic coefficient relationship.
Single runs per coefficient leave seed uncertainty around the apparent 0.25 optimum.
